messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The product catalog depends on image-resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-28]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-03]
- Boreal reported at standup on 2026-03-17 that the image-resizer's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade. [valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-17]
- Farah Haddad walked Yuki through the image-resizer runbook on 2025-06-25. [valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-image-resizer]
- Team Dune took over image-resizer from Boreal on 2026-01-20. [decision; valid 2026-01-20 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-20-image-resizer]
- On 2026-04-29, Ember noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-29]
- The image-resizer is not a Boreal service. [valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-17]
- The product catalog has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC as of 2025-11-12. [constraint; valid 2025-11-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-12]
    earlier: The product catalog has a deploy window on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-02 to 2025-11-12; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2]
- The image-resizer pager rings Team Dune, not Boreal, as of 2026-01-20. [decision; valid 2026-01-20 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The image-resizer pager rings the Boreal team, not Cinder, as of 2025-11-19. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to 2026-01-20; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-image-resizer]
- The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-01]
- As of 2026-03-20, the image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only. [decision; valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-20]
- The product catalog lived with the Cinder team from 2025-01-17 until 2025-10-20, when it moved to the Boreal team. [valid 2025-10-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-20-catalog]
    earlier: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-10-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Storage for the image-resizer's originals doubled in six months as of 2026-03-20. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-20]
- Team Dune owns image-resizer as of 2026-01-20, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-01-20 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: Boreal owns image-resizer as of 2025-11-19, after Cinder handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to 2026-01-20; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-image-resizer]
    earlier: Cinder owns image-resizer as of 2025-06-25. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-11-19; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-image-resizer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns image-resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- Diego held the Cinder on-call phone from 2025-11-25 until 2025-12-15, after which Yuki took it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]

    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-10-02, with Diego off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-08-29. [decision; valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-02; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-07-22. [decision; valid 2025-07-22 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-22]
- The Postgres 14 pin on Ledger lifts when the partitioning work finishes. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-30]
- The first on-call rotation for Team Atlas goes to Tomasz. [decision; valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- The first on-call rotation for Team Dune goes to Farah. [decision; valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-13]
